parameters.name: CaCertificate
parameters.description: The CA certificate used to verify the server certificate of the Keyless server. This parameter takes effect only when Verify is set to true.

parameters.name: ClientCertificate
parameters.description: The client certificate. This parameter must be specified together with the client private key.

parameters.name: ClientPrivateKey
parameters.description: The client private key. This parameter must be specified together with the client certificate.

parameters.name: Host
parameters.description: The hostname of the Keyless server. The value can be a domain name or an IP address.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the Keyless server.

parameters.name: Port
parameters.description: The port of the Keyless server.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: Verify
parameters.description: Specifies whether to verify the server certificate of the Keyless server. Default value: false.
